title: A carefree song on the way home
odia:
ଅଚିନ୍ତା ନାରୀ ବାପଘର ଯାଏ
ମନ ଫୁଲାଣୀଆ ଗୀତ ଗାଏ।
literal_meaning: A carefree woman goes to her father’s home, singing a cheerful song.
meaning_odia: ଚିନ୍ତା ନଥିଲେ ମନର ଆନନ୍ଦ ଗୀତରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ—ବାପଘରକୁ ଯାଉଥିବା ନାରୀର ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ଏଠାରେ ଏଭଳି ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: A carefree woman sings cheerfully while going to her father’s home. This edition reads the scene as ease showing itself in song. That is an editorial reading; the text does not explain why she is free of worry.
usage_example: After finishing a difficult piece of work, someone hums happily on the journey home. This saying could describe that unburdened mood. This is a newly composed illustration, not a recorded use.
cultural_context: The destination is ବାପଘର, the woman’s father’s home. It provides a concrete family setting for the cheerful journey. Nothing in these two lines establishes the conditions in her other household or makes this experience universal for women.

graphic.alt: A smiling woman walks along a village path carrying a small bundle, with three people at a house behind her.
graphic.caption: An imagined woman sings on her way, giving form to the verse’s carefree mood.

odia_summary: ବାପଘରକୁ ଯାଉଥିବା ନାରୀର ଗୀତରେ ଚିନ୍ତାମୁକ୍ତ ମନର ଆନନ୍ଦ।
english_summary: A carefree heart finds a cheerful song on the way to a familiar home.
